text: There are several kinds of culture, each with its use. Meristem culture gives virus free plants, because viruses do not reach the growing tip; that is how virus free seed potato is made. Anther culture gives haploid plants, and doubling them with colchicine gives perfectly pure lines in one step. Embryo rescue saves hybrids that would otherwise die in the seed. And fusing the naked protoplasts of two species gives somatic hybrids, like the pomato, potato plus tomato.
